stem: Find the line passing through the point $(3, -4)$ and parallel to the $x$-axis. Drag the two points so the line is that line.
solution: A line parallel to the $x$-axis is horizontal, so every point on it has the same $y$-value.
It passes through $(3,-4)$, so that value is $-4$.

hints.text: A line parallel to the x-axis runs left to right. Check which axis your line is parallel to.
Every point on the line must have the same y-value as the given point. Check where your line crosses the y-axis.
Think about the gradient of a line parallel to the x-axis, then make it pass through the given point.

notes: Horizontal line: m=0 in equation mode.
